_comment: #69 promotion lifecycle registry. One entry per gate-passed candidate or pre-registered challenger. Standing rule (PRD #69, adopted 2026-07-11): NOTHING is promoted without a demotion rule written in its entry BEFORE promotion — a promoted signal that stops working leaves by rule, not by debate. homily_promotions.py executes the forward checks against the #13 ledger; homily_validate.py asserts every entry names its gate artifact and demotion rule. Edit this file only by appending entries or filling a decision — never rewrite a frozen criterion after data starts accruing.

entries.promotion_basis: OWNER OVERRIDE, recorded 2026-07-12: promoted with NEITHER pre-registered condition met — the forward check had not matured (window runs to 2026-09-30) and earliest_promotion (2026-10-01, Q4's R10 slot) had not arrived. The owner directed the promotion and accepted the risk explicitly ('I can take the risk of promoting without live data'). The frozen forward-check window is UNCHANGED and its read publishes at every month-start digest check through and including 2026-10-01 regardless of this promotion; the rolling demotion rule below is armed from the promotion date and a FAIL demotes mechanically. R10 accounting: Q4-2026's promotion slot is SPENT by this early promotion (Q3's went to 🐳 WHALE-DIP, 2026-07-06); no further promoted signal-behaviour change before 2027-Q1.

forward_check.criterion: mean forward-21-ledger-row raw-close return of ⭐ rows with rank<=3 must EXCEED the mean of ⭐ rows with rank>3 over the window; fewer than min_measured_rows on either side = INSUFFICIENT, decision deferred, no promotion

entries.if_promoted: digest orders ⭐ rows by RS12 with top-3 marked; PLAYBOOK §3.4 becomes split-across-top-3; homily_buyday allocates top-3 (MAX_STARS/ordering); one session, one commit
entries.demotion_rule: if promoted: demote back to equal-split max-5 when top-3 ⭐ rows underperform other-⭐ rows on the same mean forward-21-row metric over any rolling 6-month ledger window ending after promotion; checked by homily_promotions.py at each month-start; demotion is mandatory on a failed check, not a discussion

entries.promotion_basis: OWNER OVERRIDE, recorded 2026-07-12 (#92/D-92): promoted ahead of the clean 2027-Q1 R10 slot on the owner's directive ('concentration is also ok and should be encouraged, allow me to add into winners on dips instead of keeping the 10% hard rule' + 'execute them NOW, dont stop until you're done'). The gate itself ran earlier and independently: D-67/BACKTEST_RESULTS §12 priced 25% as formally adoptable (ties-or-beats 10% in 7/9 redistribute windows, shock-MaxDD within 5 pts) at a recorded cost (−95% single-name shock payout 1.70 vs 1.89 MOIC — half the insurance surrendered deliberately). Uncapped stays excluded (its −95% cell is 1.49; excluded by pre-registered rule). R10 arithmetic: 2026-Q3 🐳 · 2026-Q4 rs12-top3 (spent early) · 2027-Q1 this entry (spent early) — the next free promotion slot is 2027-Q2, and October's #14/#85 reads must split THREE 2026 epochs.

entries.what: PLAYBOOK §5.2 Rule 2 time-stop: weeks in ⚪ CAUTION (with F:0–1) before the sell-half review fires, 12 -> 8 (#51; homily_positions.CAUTION_WEEKS)
entries.gate_artifact: homily_timestop_backtest.py — decision rule frozen in the module docstring BEFORE the first run: a challenger w must (a) win MOIC on BOTH universe-B honest windows vs the incumbent w=3, (b) not lose both universe-A windows, (c) keep MaxDD within +5 pts everywhere; minimal change wins among passers. Run 2026-07-17: PASS, passing [1,2], w=2 the minimal-change winner. Independently RE-RUN 2026-07-22 on rolled data (window 2021-07-22/2016-07-22 -> 2026-07-21): same verdict, passing [1,2], w=2. B·5y 1.95 vs 1.77 incumbent; B·10y 2.69 vs 2.51; A·5y 2.36 vs 2.35; A·10y 4.34 vs 4.27; B·10y MaxDD -62% vs -64% (better).
entries.promotion_basis: OWNER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-22: 'ignore R10, ship everything that you think will improve our odds, and backtest them rigorously.' R10's calendar spacing (next free slot 2027-Q2) was waived deliberately — see the same-day R10 re-cut, which splits survival/exit recalibrations (measurable, reversible, attributable) from selection promotions (where tuning-to-noise bites) rather than abolishing the rule. NORTH-STAR HONESTY, recorded because it cuts against the ship: this promotion does NOT make the engine beat QQQ. On the 10y honest control QQQ-DCA scores 2.86 MOIC at -34% MaxDD; the engine scores 2.51 at w=3 and 2.69 at w=2, at -64%/-62%. The change narrows a losing gap. It ships because it beats the INCUMBENT on the frozen rule, which is what it was tested for. w=1 (~4wk) was the only setting that cleared QQQ on that window (3.01) and was NOT taken: it loses A·10y (4.00 vs 4.27), takes -57% drawdown and 83% more turnover, and the frozen minimal-change clause had already selected w=2 before the QQQ column was examined. Choosing w=1 after seeing that column would be post-hoc selection toward the north star — the exact failure this registry exists to prevent.

forward_check.checker: homily_promotions.timestop_watch — paired-episode read over committed ledger rows; published at every month-start alongside the other entries, not a one-shot
forward_check.criterion: FROZEN 2026-07-22. For each ticker, EARLY flag = first CAUTION row at wk_weeks in [8,11] with F:0-1 (the band this promotion newly made actionable); LATE flag = that ticker's next CAUTION row at wk_weeks>=12 (what the old rule waited for); delta = late/early - 1. Mean delta > 0 over >= 8 paired episodes means the price rose while waiting, i.e. the earlier exit destroyed value -> FAIL -> mandatory revert of CAUTION_WEEKS to 12. Unpaired early flags are skipped, never scored as wins.

entries.if_promoted: homily_positions.CAUTION_WEEKS = 8; PLAYBOOK §5.2 Rule 2 text, homily_positions.trim_flags docstring, HOW_IT_WORKS F:n/3 row all read '8+ weeks'. homily_bear_backtest.CAUTION_MONTHS stays 3 — it is the BACKTEST replay constant and every committed table depends on it replaying byte-identically.
entries.demotion_rule: FROZEN BEFORE PROMOTION. Revert CAUTION_WEEKS to 12 (and all four text surfaces) if EITHER: (a) at the 2027-01-22 forward read, names flagged in the newly-eligible 8..11-week band underperformed, on mean forward return from flag date, what waiting to 12 weeks would have returned — i.e. the earlier exit destroyed value on live rows; or (b) any re-run of homily_timestop_backtest.py on a later window fails to keep w=2 in the passing set under the SAME frozen three-clause rule. Reversion is mandatory and mechanical, not a discussion.

entries.promotion_basis: OWNER-DIRECTED, recorded 2026-07-25: the owner ran the 3y walk-forward replay study (105,848 signals, replay validated 99.5% state-match against the live log), reviewed the result and directed implementation in the same day ('implement it'). Part III rule 5 note: study and ship happened in one session by explicit owner decision. R10 accounting, continuing the PRD §8.5 ledger: 2027-Q2's selection slot is SPENT by this promotion (Q3-2026 whale-dip · Q4-2026 rs12-top3 · 2027-Q1 add-cap-25, all early); next free selection slot 2027-Q3; #14/#14a/#85 reads now split FOUR promotion epochs.

entries.gate_artifact: homily_holdadds_backtest.py (procedure committed same session) + BACKTEST_RESULTS.md §29: DCA sim 37 buy days 2023-08..2026-07, NEW beats OLD on BOTH honest windows (2.758 vs 2.322 value-per-$ on 2023-08..2025-07 buys; 1.243 vs 1.156 on 2025-08..2026-07 buys); state-level evidence: within CONVICTION tier, HOLD-day entries beat ACCUMULATE-day entries at every horizon (60d excess +15.54% vs +5.63%, date-clustered t 15.8/10.2). CAVEATS frozen with the gate: universe as of 2026-07-11 replayed backwards (survivorship inflates ABSOLUTE returns; the OLD-vs-NEW spread is within-universe and unaffected); monthly-mark MaxDD is DEEPER under NEW (-36.4% vs -28.9%) — more return, deeper dips, accepted by the owner

entries.post_hoc_note: 2026-07-26, owner-requested honest re-test (BACKTEST_RESULTS §31, homily_holdadds_honest.py): on the hype-2021 control universe the #125 rule LOSES to the pre-#125 star-only rule at 5y (MOIC 1.51 vs 1.74) and ties at 10y (2.50 vs 2.52), and both lose to DCA QQQ at 10y (2.86). The 'CONVICTION too strict on a small universe' excuse was checked and fails — median 4 eligible names/month for BOTH arms on B. §29's advantage therefore looks like a survivorship artifact of the 2026-07-11 universe replayed backwards. This does NOT demote the entry (post-hoc tests never reverse a promotion here; the monthly hold_adds_check on live ledger rows is the only mechanism that can). Status moved to promoted-on-probation so no future session quotes §29 as validated evidence without §31.
